==='''In the Zoltan hub'''===
*''You head into a ship supply store. It is a well-equipped, self-service affair. An order is dialed into a terminal, scrap is deposited, and the item is dispatched from a nearby chute.''
** A  <span style="color:limegreen">store</span> opens.
*''You head into the cantina for gossip. Topics of conversation in the cantina range from crop distribution microbes to the joys of Slug pleasure cruises.''
**''You overhear one group discussing a newly discovered planet yet to have first contact, and note down its location.''
*** A [[#Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.


==Quest Marker==
:{{Long-Ranged Scanners info|shipdetected=noship}}

{{:Zoltan quest primitives}}

==Trivia==
This event is called "ZOLTAN_TRADE_HUB" in the datafiles.<br />
The quest marker event is called "ZOLTAN_QUEST_PRIMITIVES" in the datafiles.
* The quest part of the event can be encountered as a standalone [[Zoltan quest primitives]] event.
* The Zoltan ship at the trade hub ("ZOLTAN_SHIP") doesn't have surrender/escape chances/requirements specified (events_ships.xml).
* The Zoltan ship at the quest marker ("ZOLTAN_PRIMITIVES_ZOLTAN") doesn't have surrender/escape chances/requirements specified (events_ships.xml).
* The Rebel ship at the quest marker ("ZOLTAN_PRIMITIVES_REBEL") doesn't have surrender/escape chances/requirements specified (events_ships.xml).
